title: 卡通风格的应用程序图标
prompt: Colorful, cartoon-style app icon design for a [type of app: game, movie, food, sport, etc.] logo with the text ["App Name"] and [character, symbol, or cute object + short description of its pose or action] on the front of a square button, set against a [background color / theme] with simple details. High-resolution game art and graphics for a mobile app, Pixar style, realistic.
description: 使用Nano Banana Pro或Nano Banana Pro模型，轻松生成色彩鲜艳的卡通风格应用图标，特别适合游戏和美食类应用，提升移动应用的视觉吸引力。这些设计融合了俏皮角色和生动主题，帮助应用在市场中脱颖而出。
